Write a Review Menu Menu An Alliance of Dentists Refining Our Dental Scrap Rethink Dental Scrap Refining Many of our fellow dentists have been using the same refiner for many years and have given no thought to change. It is time to rethink old habits. If your refiners haven’t paid you $100,000.00 or more over the last 30 years, then you have funded their retirements, not yours! This number only estimates the total payout. If the money were saved and invested, then it could easily grow to seven figures. The president of NDRC is a dentist who founded this company on the principle that his fellow dentists should be paid at what the insurance industry calls “Fee for Service Payout.” Unfortunately, currently, the refining industry pays the dentist at an HMO rate, or sometimes PPO rate, which they describe as “We Pay the Most” or “98% Return,” without defining the basis for these rates. You, the dentist, deserve a “Fee for Service Payout” on your scrap metals. The largest chunk of payout should go to the dentist, not to the refinery. FREE REPORT Find out what your Dental Scrap is REALLY worth Easily Send Your Dental Scrap We provide fully insured shipping directly from your office to ours via FedEx. Receive automatic e-mail or text notification on receipt of your packages and settlements Professional Processing of Metals & PFMs We are extremely experienced in the methods required to process your crowns and bridges into homogeneous form for spectrometer analysis, including multiple melting and spectrometer analyses. Settlement NDRC provides the highest possible Fee for Service payout to our members, an alliance of dentists. You’ll receive your prompt settlement by check. Referral Program Refer a colleague: when the dentist new to NDRC uses our service, you are moved to a 5% tier on your future payouts. Premium Services Our Concierge Program provides enhanced services that give dentists convenience, flexibility, and control, from the weigh-in to consignment, sale, and final settlement. Write a Review Menu Menu About Us Nationwide Dental Refining Club, NDRC is a dentist own refining based in Scottsdale, Arizona serving dentists across the United States. NDRC is your peer and your advocate inside the dental refining industry. NDRC is different than your current refiner, our co-founder is a licensed practicing dentist like yourself looking for the best value for dental scrap. As many of you attend continuing education meetings whether in-person or virtual, NDRC attends as well. It is common within the meetings we attend for dentists processing their scrap with us, to give unsolicited HIGH recommendations for our services.
